subject: [PATCH v5 0/4] arm64: cross-CPU NMI via SDEI

reviews.author: YinFengwei
reviews.summary:
Reviewer YinFengwei pointed out that the patch does not handle the case where SDEI is disabled in firmware, which would prevent the cross-CPU NMI from working.

The reviewer confirmed that the patchset works on their Neoverse N2 platform and provided a Tested-by tag.

 Tested-by: Yin Fengwei <fengwei_yin@linux.alibaba.com>

Regards
Yin, Fengwei

2026-07-03.patch_summary: This patch series adds a new mechanism to deliver interrupts across CPUs on arm64 systems, specifically targeting scenarios where the CPU has its interrupts locally masked. The current pseudo-NMI and FEAT_NMI mechanisms have limitations, such as introducing a significant performance overhead or requiring architectural support that is not yet widely deployed. This series introduces SDEI (System Description Event Infrastructure) as a new delivery backend, which allows firmware to deliver an interrupt into a CPU regardless of its DAIF state, thus enabling the backtrace and crash-stop paths to reach a masked CPU without incurring significant performance costs.
